Soft apple oat rounds

Almás korong

7 months+ Adjusted 25 min 8 portions

Serve soft rounds the same day if you can. Do not dry them into hard apple rings.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 large Eating apple (Peeled, cored, and grated)
  • 2 tablespoons Water (To cook the apple soft)
  • 90 g Rolled oats (Stirred in after the apple is soft)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Cook the grated apple with the water until soft.
  2. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  3. Stir in the oats and press thick rounds onto a lined tray.
  4. Bake only until set, about 12 minutes.
  5. Cool and serve while the rounds still give under a finger.

Adjusted

Hard dried apple is a choking food. These are soft rounds, not dried apple rings.

Mix soft cooked apple with oats and bake rounds that stay tender. Do not dry them until they turn hard.
